decisions.header: Retain prior header_text_patch contract: Option<&StylePatch>, defaultNone, forward through key/row builders. HEADER remains background/default text and whole-header slot. Without slot, canonical HEADER resolution with existing global/part patches first and text patch last. None byte-identical; no new Part, registry target or input behavior. Holla uses frozen Heading muted/no-bold ink; Showcase uses frozen sidebar faint ink. Do not blindly bless current TAG_GREY as universal theme recipe.
decisions.prefix: Holla: existing header_indent(3), content_gap(0), no icon callback, CursorStyle::Fill. Showcase: additive marker_gap(u16), default0, requested1, yields marker at+1, blank+2, icon+3, content gap1, label+5; same gap applies collapsed icon. Propagate into measurement and clipping. Do not shift GUTTER or MARKER themselves.
decisions.columns: Add one general intrinsic column solver to termrock-layout, using frozen Col algorithm semantics: min/ideal/max/flex/drop-priority and visible-only gaps. Factor the existing private ItemColumns solver onto it only with exact default parity proof; do not create a second solver or widen Picker schema for Holla.
decisions.consumer_adapter: Navigation owns an additive measured-column row adapter above RowUi. Data projection yields borrowed text, match indices, semantic style patch and overflow policy per named column. Policy declares intrinsic/fixed/flex sizes, preferred relative cap and drop priority. Library measures every displayed logical item before clipping, solves once per layout, then feeds resolved widths to existing RowUi column cells; apps do not calculate widths/Rects. For Holla label cap is36%, floor14 then capped by intrinsic maximum; reason minimum12/flex1/drop1; gap2 and trailing reserve1. These numbers are explicit layout policy, not viewport whitelist.
decisions.overflow: Expose only consumed generic cell overflow policies: end ellipsis, separator-preserving truncation, middle truncation where another real consumer needs it. Use termrock-text grapheme/cell tools and existing reveal services. Do not reuse CellUi.text raw clipping where frozen ellipsis/reveal is required; label_matched currently has ellipsis but reason does not.
decisions.gutter: Scrollbar space policy is distinct from row prefix. Holla overflow-only existing policy; Showcase frozen reserves the last column even without overflow. Add a documented stable scrollbar gutter option to shared ScrollRegion/NavList only when migrating Showcase, defaultAuto unchanged. Do not emulate by app-side Rect subtraction or reserve twice on overflow.
decisions.ownership: Holla owns rank/catalogue/query domain projections, kind/scope/risk labels, row ordering and actions. Termrock owns row/header geometry, measured columns, clipping, cursor/selection/hover/press styles, hit rows, scroll state, and reveal behavior. No whole World/App passed to components.
